suite: 3D pane follows the selection (sweep, bind, reload, hover)
expect_red: [real] clicking a contributor row with the pane open keeps the page on the study and the annotator in sweep mode, the edge highlighted

mutations.contract: On a kinematic page a selection is a highlight, never a goto.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_kinematic_page_keeps_the_dag_and_says_each_contributor_once (2026-10-26). Asks the pane for the edge's goto when one is selected, which takes the scene out of the sweep.
mutations.find: return run ? { topologyId: study.topology, sweep: run, kinematicId: study.id } : null;
mutations.replace: return view.selection && view.selection.kind === "edge" ? { topologyId: study.topology, edgeId: view.selection.id } : run ? { topologyId: study.topology, sweep: run, kinematicId: study.id } : null;
